name: SEMrush
tagline: SEMrush is an all-in-one digital marketing toolkit covering SEO, PPC, content marketing, social media, and competitive research. Its AI-powered features include a writing assistant that optimises content for target keywords, automated site health audits, and a traffic analytics tool that estimates competitor performance. Over 10 million marketing professionals use SEMrush to grow organic traffic and outmanoeuvre competition.
